studio.desc: IDE nativa para TMJLite: explorer, editor SQL com abas e histórico, grid editável paginado, EXPLAIN, mock data, índices, export CSV/JSON. Painel git-native: branches, commit, log e merge com dry-run e conflitos lado a lado. Abre SQLite e importa CSV/SQLite para .tmjp.
studio.note: macOS: assinado com Developer ID e notarizado pela Apple — abre sem avisos.

drivers.name: Python
drivers.desc: Instale pelo PyPI: o wheel já traz o motor nativo para macOS (Apple Silicon), Linux x64 e Windows x64 — sem build, sem configuração.
drivers.code:
import tmjlite

db = tmjlite.connect("app.tmjp")
db.execute("CREATE TABLE t (id PK, name TEXT);")
for row in db.query("SELECT * FROM t;"):
    print(row["name"])

drivers.code:
import tmjlite "github.com/TMJPlatform/tmjlite-go"

db, _ := tmjlite.Open("app.tmjp")
defer db.Close()
db.Execute("CREATE TABLE t (id PK, name TEXT);")
result, _ := db.Query("SELECT * FROM t;")
